title: Kissed Crispy Thai Lamb Skewers
description: A pungent and crispy Thai dish featuring lamb shanks, long-fermentation-dough, and a blend of spices, perfect for a crowd-pleasing snack or appetizer. This diabetic-friendly dish is made with wholesome ingredients and is easy to prepare.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, and vegetable oil.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb pieces and long-fermentation-dough pieces onto skewers.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the skewers with the marinade and sprinkle with garlic and ginger.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
While the skewers are baking, heat the Thai red curry paste in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Brush the skewers with the curry paste and return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
